unresolved_effect_boundaries: The DLL imports CreateThread, waits/timer queues, filesystem mutation, Winsock, LDAP and cryptographic APIs. This inventory is not proof that each occurs during attach or this RadsInitialize case, and the partial callgraph is not proof they cannot occur.
Indirect vtables, dynamically resolved exports, exception/SEH handlers, callback reentrancy and all initializer descendants are not exhaustively resolved.
No network, filesystem, event, semaphore, ETW or DLL action was invoked by this review. Future unknown imports must stop before host effects instead of receiving synthetic results.

Opcode extraction follows local direct branches with a fixed window; out-of-window/indirect branches are explicitly retained as boundaries. Ordered-instruction byte hashes are hashes of selected instruction bytes, not claims that disjoint ranges form one contiguous function body.
Native detach, allocation failure, real threading and asynchronous callback scheduling remain execution qualification work, not conclusions of this static preparation.
